items.title: John E. Wood Interview, 1986-06-26
items.q: The interviewee discusses Paul Barber's bands and mentions saying something to 'him' about wanting to hear music, but does not describe a direct personal interaction or professional collaboration with Barber himself.

ctx.x: Yeah. But back to Paul Barber and about what year would that have been?

That would have been, I would say, I came here in the summer of 55. And I don't think I really... The first parades that we went to were the following summer. We were here just for the last half of the summer and had just barely gotten oriented to the city and the campus and all of that. And it wasn't, I guess it was the summer of 56. It was probably the summer of 56.
